what: Run-to-run disagreement of claude-haiku-4-5 at DEFAULT temperature
how: Two independent runs of the same 50 gold items at L3. Restricted to items where the Level 2 loop made zero rejections, so both runs took an identical path — one model call, accepted immediately. Any disagreement is therefore the model itself, not the loop.
consequence: This is the empirical justification for pinning temperature=0 on the worker role for the sweep. A 13% disagreement floor would swamp the pre-registered L0 one-shot vs L0 loop effect. Sonnet 5 rejects non-default sampling parameters, so its floor cannot be removed and its error bars are not comparable to Haiku pinned.
denominator_note: Reported as 6 of 37, not 6 of 45. 45 is the count of items the loop never touched; 37 is how many of those ran and returned in BOTH runs and can therefore be paired. An item only one run answered is not a disagreement, and counting it in the denominator would understate the floor. 6/45 = 13.3% is the looser figure; 6/37 = 16.2% is the one with a valid denominator.
